title: 집에서 보내는 휴가
intro: 집에서 보내는 휴가는 '휴가 때 집에서 하는 일 → 휴가 중 하루 일과 → 기억에 남는 집 휴가 → 여행 vs 집 휴가 의견'으로 출제됩니다. 서울 아파트(10층, 내 방, 거실)에서 가족과 함께 늦잠 자기, 넷플릭스 영화 몰아보기, 가족 외식을 핵심 장면으로 정하면 집·영화·동네 주제와 자연스럽게 연결됩니다. '학기 중에 너무 바빠서 휴가 때는 푹 쉬고 싶다'는 이유를 꼭 넣으세요.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Oh, ~? Let me think.) → 언제·누구와(방학, 가족) → 하는 일 세부(늦잠, 영화 몰아보기, 외식) → 집 휴가를 좋아하는 이유·느낌 → 마무리 문장(That's why I really like ~)
하루 일과 질문은 아침(늦잠) → 오후(산책·카페·조깅) → 저녁(가족 외식) → 밤(영화) 시간 순서로 말하세요.
영화·음악·조깅·동네 공원 등 다른 주제에서 쓴 표현을 그대로 가져와 재활용하면 준비 시간이 줄어듭니다.
여행 vs 집 휴가 의견 질문은 입장 → 장점·단점 각각 → 내 선택과 이유 → 결론 순서로 정리하세요.

expressions.en: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think.
expressions.ko: 아, 집에서 보내는 휴가요? 생각해 볼게요.

expressions.en: I sleep in until about ten.
I watch movies on Netflix all day.
We go out to eat as a family.
I just stay in my pajamas.
I don't have to worry about classes.
I binge-watch a whole series in one day.
expressions.ko: 시리즈 하나를 하루 만에 몰아 봐요.

expressions.en: My semester is so busy that I just want to rest.
expressions.ko: 학기가 너무 바빠서 그냥 쉬고 싶어요.

expressions.en: It's a great way to recharge.
On the other hand, traveling can be really tiring.
expressions.ko: 반면에 여행은 정말 피곤할 수 있어요.

expressions.en: That's why I really like spending my vacations at home.
expressions.ko: 그래서 저는 집에서 휴가 보내는 걸 정말 좋아해요.

expressions.en: There's nothing better than doing nothing after a long semester.
expressions.ko: 긴 학기가 끝나고 아무것도 안 하는 것보다 좋은 건 없어요.

expressions.en: I didn't realize how much I needed it until I actually rested.
expressions.ko: 실제로 쉬어 보고 나서야 그게 얼마나 필요했는지 깨달았어요.
expressions.note: not A until B: B하고 나서야 A하다

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you spend your vacations at home. What do you usually do during a vacation at home, and why do you prefer staying home?
questions.ko: 설문에서 휴가를 집에서 보낸다고 하셨습니다. 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때 보통 무엇을 하고, 왜 집에 있는 걸 더 좋아하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제(방학)·누구와(가족) → 하는 일 3가지(늦잠, 영화 몰아보기, 가족 외식) → 집에 있는 걸 좋아하는 이유 → 마무리
이유는 '학기 중 너무 바쁨 → 쉬고 싶음', '돈이 안 듦', '가족과 시간' 중 2개를 고르세요.
거실 소파, 내 방 침대처럼 집 주제의 장소를 넣으면 장면이 생생해집니다.

answers.IM3: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think. I usually spend my vacations at home with my family. First, I sleep in until about ten. Then I watch movies on Netflix all day. I like comedies and action movies. In the evening, my family and I often go out to eat. I like staying home because my school life is really busy. At home, I can rest and feel relaxed. Yeah, that's what I usually do on vacation.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about my vacations at home. I'm a college student, and my semester is so busy that I usually just want to rest when vacation starts. So I spend most of my vacation at home in Seoul with my family. The first thing I do is sleep in. I don't set an alarm at all, and I usually wake up around ten or eleven. Then I lie on the sofa in the living room and binge-watch movies or a whole series on Netflix. I love comedies and action movies, so I can watch them for hours. In the evening, my family and I go out to eat at a restaurant in our neighborhood. I like staying home because it's cheap and comfortable, and I don't have to plan anything. It's a great way to recharge. That's why I really like spending my vacations at home.
answers.AL: Oh, what I do on vacation at home? Let me think. Well, honestly, I'm a total homebody when it comes to vacations. During the semester, my life is pretty hectic. I have tons of classes, team projects, and a thirty-minute subway ride to school every day, so by the time vacation comes around, I'm completely exhausted. That's why I usually spend my vacations at home with my family. My day pretty much starts whenever I wake up, which is usually around ten or eleven. I stay in my pajamas, make some toast, and then I set myself up on the sofa in the living room. That's where the real fun begins, because I binge-watch movies on Netflix, mostly comedies and action movies. Sometimes my younger brother Junho joins me, and we argue about what to watch next. In the evening, my whole family goes out to eat at a restaurant in our neighborhood, which is one of my favorite parts of the day. The reason I prefer staying home is simple. There's nothing better than doing nothing after a long semester. I don't have to plan anything or spend a lot of money, and I get to really recharge. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacations at home.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical day when you are on vacation at home. What do you do from the morning until night, and who do you spend the time with?
questions.ko: 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때의 평범한 하루에 대해 말해 주세요. 아침부터 밤까지 무엇을 하고, 누구와 시간을 보내나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 아침(늦잠, 아침 식사) → 오후(공원 산책·카페·조깅) → 저녁(가족 외식) → 밤(영화) → 마무리
In the morning / In the afternoon / In the evening / At night 로 시간대를 분명히 나누세요.
누구와 함께하는지(엄마, 아빠, Junho, 가끔 Minji)를 시간대마다 하나씩 넣으면 디테일이 풍부해져요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about a typical vacation day at home. In the morning, I sleep in until about ten. Then I eat a late breakfast with my mom. In the afternoon, I take a walk in the small park near my apartment, or I go to a café. In the evening, I have dinner with my family. At night, I watch a movie on Netflix in my room. It's a really simple day, but I love it. Yeah, that's my typical vacation day at home.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about a typical day on vacation. In the morning, I sleep in as late as I want, usually until ten or so. When I get up, I have a late breakfast with my mom, and we just chat about random stuff. In the afternoon, I try to get out of the house a little. I take a walk in the small park near my apartment, or I meet my friend Minji at a café in my neighborhood and drink an iced Americano. Sometimes I go jogging along the Han River, because it's only ten minutes away by bike. In the evening, my dad comes home, and my whole family goes out to eat, usually at a Korean barbecue place. At night, I lie on my bed and watch movies on my laptop until really late. It's a simple day, but it's exactly what I need after a busy semester. So yeah, that's pretty much my typical vacation day.
answers.AL: Oh, a typical vacation day at home? Let me think. Well, it's honestly the complete opposite of a school day. During the semester, I'm up at seven and rushing to the subway, but on vacation, I turn off my alarm and sleep in until about ten or eleven. When I finally get up, I usually have a late brunch with my mom, who loves to tell me all the neighborhood gossip. In the afternoon, I try not to stay on the sofa the whole day, so I take a slow walk in the little park near our apartment while listening to IU. If Minji is free, we meet up at our favorite café in the neighborhood, order iced Americanos, and talk for hours about everything except school. On some days, I ride my bike to the Han River and go jogging there for about thirty minutes, which really clears my head. In the evening, my dad gets home from work, and the four of us, including my brother Junho, go out to eat. We usually pick a barbecue place or a noodle restaurant nearby. At night, I crawl into bed with my laptop and watch movies until two in the morning, because I can. Yeah, that's my perfect vacation day at home.

questions.en: Tell me about a memorable vacation you spent at home. When was it, what did you do, and did anyone visit you? Why was it so memorable?
questions.ko: 집에서 보낸 기억에 남는 휴가에 대해 말해 주세요. 언제였고, 무엇을 했으며, 누가 찾아왔나요? 왜 그렇게 기억에 남나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제(지난 겨울방학) → 무슨 일(Minji가 놀러 와서 같이 영화 몰아보기, 배달 음식) → 그때 감정 → 기억에 남는 이유 → 마무리
과거 시제를 일관되게 쓰고, 처음 계획과 실제로 일어난 일을 대비시키면 이야기가 살아납니다.
AL은 'I didn't realize ~ until ~' 같은 깨달음 문장으로 마무리 직전에 감정을 정리하세요.

answers.IM3: Oh, a memorable vacation at home? Let me think. It was last winter vacation. After my final exams, I was really tired, so I stayed home for a week. On one weekend, my friend Minji came over to my apartment. We watched three movies in a row in the living room. We ordered fried chicken and talked a lot. My mom made us hot chocolate. It was so fun and cozy. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. It was last winter vacation. My final exams had just finished, and I was completely exhausted, so I decided to stay home for the whole week. On the first few days, I just slept in and watched movies alone. Then on Saturday, my friend Minji came over to my place. It was snowing outside, so we decided not to go out at all. We made a big blanket fort on the sofa in the living room and watched three movies in a row, two comedies and one action movie. We ordered fried chicken, and my mom even made hot chocolate for us. Later, my brother Junho joined us, and we played board games until midnight. It was such a simple day, but I laughed so much. That's why it was the most memorable vacation I've spent at home.
answers.AL: Oh, a memorable vacation at home? Let me think. Yeah, I definitely remember one. It was last winter vacation, right after my final exams. That semester was really rough, because I had a ton of team projects in my business classes, and I was basically running on coffee and four hours of sleep. So when vacation started, I decided I wasn't going anywhere. For the first few days, I literally didn't leave the apartment. I slept until noon, stayed in my pajamas, and binge-watched movies on Netflix. Then on Saturday, my best friend Minji texted me and asked if she could come over. It was snowing like crazy outside, so we decided to have a movie marathon at my place. We built a little blanket fort on the sofa in the living room, ordered fried chicken, and watched three movies in a row. My mom made us hot chocolate, and later my brother Junho joined us for board games, which got way too competitive. We were laughing so hard that my dad came out of his room to see what was going on. Honestly, I didn't realize how much I needed a day like that until I actually had it. So yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.

questions.en: Some people like to travel during their vacations, while others prefer to stay home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each? Which do you prefer and why?
questions.ko: 어떤 사람들은 휴가 때 여행하는 것을 좋아하고, 어떤 사람들은 집에 있는 것을 선호합니다. 각각의 장단점은 무엇인가요? 당신은 어느 쪽을 더 좋아하고 그 이유는 무엇인가요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 여행의 장점·단점(새로운 경험 vs 돈·피로) → 집 휴가의 장점·단점(편함·저렴 vs 지루할 수 있음) → 내 선택과 이유(내 경험 예시) → 마무리
On the one hand / On the other hand 로 장단점을 나누면 구조가 분명해집니다.
예시는 작년 여름 오사카 가족 여행(재미있지만 피곤)과 지난 겨울방학 집 휴가(푹 쉼)로 페르소나 이야기를 재활용하세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you what I think. Traveling is fun because you can see new places and try new food. But it costs a lot of money, and it can be tiring. Staying home is cheap and comfortable, but it can be a little boring. For me, I prefer staying home. My school life is really busy, so I just want to rest on vacation. I can sleep in and watch movies. Yeah, that's why I like staying home more.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I think both have advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, traveling is exciting. You can see new places, try new food, and make special memories. For example, last summer my family went to Osaka, and it was a lot of fun. On the other hand, traveling can be really tiring and expensive. We walked all day in the heat, and I was exhausted when I got back. Staying home is the opposite. It's cheap and comfortable, and you don't have to plan anything. The only downside is that it can get boring after a few days. Personally, I prefer staying home for most of my vacations. My semester is so busy that I really need time to rest and recharge. I'd rather sleep in and watch movies with my family. That's why I really like spending my vacations at home.
answers.AL: Oh, travel or stay home? Let me think. Honestly, I think both have pretty clear pros and cons. On the one hand, traveling gives you experiences you just can't get at home. You see new places, try food you've never had before, and make memories with the people you love. When my family went to Osaka last summer, we still talk about the street food and the crazy lines at Universal Studios. On the other hand, traveling can be expensive and surprisingly exhausting. We walked around all day in the heat, and by the end of the trip, I honestly felt like I needed another vacation just to recover. Staying home is basically the opposite. It costs almost nothing, it's super comfortable, and you don't have to plan a single thing. The downside is that it can feel a little boring, and sometimes you feel like you wasted your free time. For me, though, I'd choose staying home most of the time. As a business major, my semester is so packed that what I really need is rest, not more schedules. Last winter vacation, I just stayed home, watched movies, and hung out with Minji and my family, and I felt completely recharged. That said, I'd still take one big trip a year. So yeah, that's pretty much how I feel about it.

pronunciation.tip: 두 번째 음절 '케이'에 강세. v는 윗니로 아랫입술을 살짝 물고 소리 내요.
끝의 -xed 는 '렉스트'처럼 [kst] 로 짧게 끝내요. '릴랙스드'가 아닙니다.
h는 소리 내지 않아요. '이그저스티드', x는 [gz] 소리예요.
첫 음절에 강세, '컴프터블' 세 음절처럼 빠르게 말해요.
